clue.text: Verne cast, in a way, as a writer before his time

indicators.note: in a way says the letters of the two words before it are recast in some other order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Jules Verne has been cast, after a fashion, as a prophet ahead of his era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a way' is the anagram signal. 'Before his time' looks like praise for the visionary Verne, but it means simply living earlier: the Spanish novelist died centuries before Verne was born.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of Don Quixote lived some 250 years before Verne, so he is a writer of an earlier era.
